09439_fallback_retry.reason: First fallback produced 2352 paired frames but only 12 lighting events. In clean frame309, EA_LOD is 2.8049% drawn (pixel bbox2.8974%) and EA_HideCube is 1.8502% (bbox1.9922%). Both have census owners and are absent from bounds-visible; floor/pawn are the only bounds-visible entries. AnomalyViewport.cpp:57 defaults to6%, :572 rejects below that bounds filter.
